node.statement: Since |R|=|U|+1, epsilon_R=W.L*epsilon<=t_2, and 0<=t_2<=W.r_reset, apply lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation to the explicit Stage-2 raw call with D=D_*. The resulting v_R:M_{|R|}->A_R is bijective and hence an extended isomorphism, has d_R<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_R and ||v_R(I_{M_{|R|}})-u_{A_R}||<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_R, and retains the same source, target corner, and amplification form, proving the induction step.
